items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: And I see Paul Barbera, I mean, he was good at that time too.

ctx.x: Where did you hear him, whose band was he with when you heard it?
He was with P. Rohn. P. Rohn. That's one of the best drumming head, you know, in fact, I mean, he's one of the best. And I see Paul Barbera, I mean, he was good at that time too.
